children: Americold posted an investor presentation highlighting the closed EQT joint venture that generated ~$1.15 billion of net proceeds used to reduce leverage and reiterated 2026 adjusted FFO guidance of $1.26–$1.32 per share.
Posted investor deck on website and furnished Exhibit 99.1 under Regulation FD for investor meetings.
Closed joint venture with EQT on Aug 31, 2026: ~$1.3B total value, ~$1.15B proceeds to Americold, 70% EQT/30% Americold.
Proceeds used to pay down debt and expected to yield ~$46M annual interest savings and de-lever balance sheet.
Reiterated 2026 adjusted FFO guidance of $1.26–$1.32 per share after ~($0.05) JV impact from prior ranges.
Deck details strategic priorities: portfolio exits, ~$100M identified cost savings, Project Orion tech rollout, and selective lower-risk development pipeline.
